steps: A x B: A is wife of B
B / C: B is father of C, so A is mother of C
C + D: C is mother of D
A is mother of D's mother: mother's mother
check_code:
rel={('A','C'):'mother',('C','D'):'mother'}
# A wife of B, B father of C => A mother of C; C mother of D
chain=[rel[('A','C')],rel[('C','D')]]
ans="Mother’s mother" if chain==['mother','mother'] else None
opts={'A':"Father’s mother",'B':"Mother’s father",'C':"Father’s father",'D':"Mother’s mother"}
assert ans==opts['D']
for k in 'ABC': assert ans!=opts[k]

steps: Figure: rotated square P1-P2-R-P7, pentagon C-P3-P4-P5-P6, vertical P2-C, lines C-R, P3-R, and long line P1-P5
Mark intersections X1 (P2R x CP3), X2 (P1P5 x P7R), X3 (P1P5 x CP6), X4 (P7R x CP6)
Enumerate triples joined by drawn lines and not collinear: CP2R, CP2X1, CP3R, CRX1, CRX4, P1P7X2, P3RX1, P5P6X3, X2X3X4 = 9
check_code:
from itertools import combinations
lines=[["P1","P2"],["P2","X1","R"],["P1","P7"],["P7","X4","X2","R"],["P2","C"],["C","X1","P3"],["C","X3","X4","P6"],["P3","P4"],["P4","P5"],["P5","P6"],["P3","R"],["C","R"],["P1","X3","X2","P5"]]
seg=lambda a,b: any(a in l and b in l for l in lines)
col=lambda a,b,c: any(a in l and b in l and c in l for l in lines)
pts=sorted({p for l in lines for p in l})
n=sum(1 for c in combinations(pts,3) if seg(c[0],c[1]) and seg(c[1],c[2]) and seg(c[0],c[2]) and not col(*c))
assert n==9
for v in (11,7,8): assert n!=v

method: Figure series: rotating line plus number shift
steps: Short line from diagonal midpoint cycles through corners BR, BL, TL, TR, so the 5th figure returns to BR with the BL-TR diagonal (A, B, C have this; D does not)
Bottom number = previous figure's top number: 4->4, 6->6, 3->3, so bottom = 8 (rules out A)
The top holds a new number each time; B (5) gives a new number, whereas C repeats 3. Low certainty
Each figure adds one new symbol, moving clockwise along the border: top-left, top-middle, top-right, right-middle
Next goes at bottom-right and is a new symbol: R
Option D has A, circle, S, T, R at bottom-right
1st letters M,P,S,?,Y (+3) -> V
